finding.subject: Global post-run preservation claim
finding.evidence: preservation-interim.json is timestamped 1789995810.884. lilconfig-P1 begins at 1789995443.421 and its native trace completes at approximately 1789996013.694, so the only global original/live-install preservation snapshot predates completion of the final timed run. No preservation-final.json exists in the evidence directory. Per-run integrity does not replace a final readback of the original dirty checkout and live installs.
finding.impact: The result document's present-tense claim that the original dirty workspace, production package and live installs were preserved lacks end-of-experiment global evidence. It does not affect the six timing rows, machine outcome, qualification screen, or run-local frozen-integrity receipts.
finding.supported_change: Before finalizing the report, run the existing preservation readback again after all timed work and save a final, timestamped receipt that compares the same original checkout status/diff hashes and live-install tree hashes. Until it exists, change only the global-preservation sentence to say that per-run integrity passed and final global preservation readback is pending. Do not alter timing, repair, quality, or promotion conclusions.
